title: When and Where to Look: Adaptive Visual Evidence Scheduling for Efficient Long Video Understanding
title_zh: 何时看、看哪里：面向高效长视频理解的自适应视觉证据调度
abstract_en: Efficient long-video understanding requires vision--language models (VLMs) to reason over a small number of frames selected as sparse visual evidence. Existing relevance-based methods rely on static one-shot selection with fixed frame budgets and candidate pools, while agent-based schedulers achieve adaptivity through costly multi-round reasoning and interactive search. We propose EcoFrame, a training-free framework for low-overhead query-adaptive visual evidence scheduling. EcoFrame leverages the VLM's inference feedback to determine when to increase the frame budget and where to search for additional candidate evidence. Specifically, entropy-gated budget scheduling uses output uncertainty to stop early when the current evidence is sufficient or progressively expand the frame budget otherwise. Meanwhile, attention-guided candidate proposal converts frame-level attention into a temporal prior, enabling dense local search in informative regions while preserving global coverage when attention is diffuse. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate that EcoFrame achieves a better accuracy--efficiency trade-off across multiple VLM backbones. On Qwen2.5-VL, EcoFrame achieves an average accuracy of 64.4, surpassing BOLT at 63.5, while providing a $1.85\times$ speedup over AKS and BOLT. Compared with the agent-based A.I.R., EcoFrame maintains comparable accuracy with up to a $13.5\times$ inference speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/EcoFrame.
abstract_zh: 长视频理解要求 vision-language models（VLMs）在少量稀疏抽取的帧上进行推理，以降低计算开销。现有基于相关性的方法通常采用一次性静态选择，帧预算和候选池固定；而 agent-based 调度器虽具备自适应性，却依赖多轮推理和交互式搜索，成本较高。本文提出 EcoFrame，一个无需训练（training-free）的低开销、查询自适应视觉证据调度框架。EcoFrame 利用 VLM 推理过程中的反馈来决定何时增加帧预算、以及在哪里搜索额外候选证据。具体而言，entropy-gated budget scheduling 通过输出不确定性判断当前证据是否足够，若足够则提前停止，否则逐步扩展帧预算；attention-guided candidate proposal 将帧级注意力转化为时间先验，在信息丰富区域进行密集局部搜索，同时在注意力分散时保持全局覆盖。实验表明，在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 MLVU 上，EcoFrame 在多个 VLM backbones 中实现了更优的准确率—效率权衡。基于 Qwen2.5-VL，EcoFrame 平均准确率达到 64.4，超过 BOLT 的 63.5，并相较 AKS 和 BOLT 提供 1.85× 加速；与 agent-based A.I.R. 相比，EcoFrame 在保持相近准确率的同时最高实现 13.5× 推理加速。
key_points_zh: 提出 EcoFrame：一个 training-free 的长视频视觉证据调度框架，面向低开销、query-adaptive 的帧选择。
通过 entropy-gated budget scheduling 根据 VLM 输出不确定性动态决定是否增加帧预算，可在证据充分时提前停止。
通过 attention-guided candidate proposal 将帧级注意力转为时间先验，在关键片段密集搜索，并在注意力分散时保留全局覆盖。
在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench、MLVU 上验证，EcoFrame 在多种 VLM backbones 上取得更好的准确率—效率折中。
在 Qwen2.5-VL 上平均准确率 64.4，超过 BOLT 的 63.5；相较 AKS/BOLT 加速 1.85×，相较 A.I.R. 最高加速 13.5×。

llm_assessment.comment: Useful efficient long-video frame scheduling work with relevance to streaming evidence selection, but it remains closer to offline VLM inference than agent interaction.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作在高效长视频帧调度方面有用，并与流式证据选择相关，但整体仍更接近离线VLM推理而非智能体交互。
